# The Broke Backpacker

> > Budget travel guides, gear reviews, and backpacking resources for adventurers exploring destinations worldwide on a shoestring budget.

The Broke Backpacker is a comprehensive travel resource founded by adventure travelers for budget-conscious explorers. The site features detailed gear reviews from brands like REI and North Face, hostel and accommodation guides, destination itineraries across Australia, Europe, North America, and beyond, plus practical advice for solo travelers and backpackers.

## Key Topics

- Budget Travel
- Backpacking Gear Reviews
- Hostel Reviews
- Solo Travel
- Camping & Outdoor Gear
- Destination Guides
- Where to Stay Guides
- Travel Photography Equipment
- Motorcycle Adventure
- Budget Accommodation
- REI Gear
- North Face Equipment
- Pacific Coast Highway
- Australia & New Zealand Travel
- European Backpacking
